Sam (AE): Priyanka at MeridianPay sent a short list: BYO KMS (customer HSM), weekly KEK rotations, proof of rotation (signed attestations), and a failover plan with <2min RTO. Also asked for cost delta for reserved vs burst during failover.
Rox (Solutions Eng): Quick clarifying q: do they want us to perform unwrapping in their HSM (proxy-only) or allow Redwood to unwrap when wrapped DEKs are provided? That affects attestation and latency.
Priyanka (Customer): We prefer unwrap-only-in-customer-HSM. Redwood should never see plaintext. Need to see network/IPs and sample API calls.
Ivy (Security): OK we can support proxy-unwrap. Requirements: vendor-signed attestation chain, SOC2 evidence, and a rotation audit log. Pen-test must include HSM handshake.
Jon (SRE): Operational note: proxy-unwrap adds ~15-45ms per unwrap. Recommend DEK caching per-session with TTL 3m to balance load. Warm failover will need ~60-120s to rehydrate caches.
Rox (Solutions Eng): I'll sketch two modes in arch note: 1) Active-passive warm failover (lower cost, 1-2min RTO), 2) Active-active sync (higher cost, <500ms RTO).
Sam (AE): Customer asks about billing: if traffic moves to secondary region, do we charge burst immediately?
Jon (SRE): Billing: reserved capacity billed per-region; burst billed when reserved exhausted. For POC we can propose a temporary waiver for cross-region bursts (subject to Finance).
Ivy (Security): Pen-test scope: read-only access to relevant logs, signed rotation attestations, and network reachability test. Legal will need indemnity for destructive tests.
Priyanka (Customer): We can provide SOC2 and HSM vendor cert. Pen-test preferred week 3630005000. We'll confirm IPs.
Rox (Solutions Eng): Action items: Rox: arch + runbook with ports and curl examples. Jon: operational TTL recommendation + failover timeline. Ivy: pen-test checklist and attestation format. Sam: coordinate finance for burst waiver.
deploy-bot: Created doc: /runbooks/sales/meridianpay-cmk-proxy-presales.md
Sam (AE): Thanks team — I'll update Priyanka. Keep this thread for blockers. :thumbsup:
